name: Craft Meme Maker
description: Make a captioned photo meme from one attached or Stash image. Upload with Save to Stash, then run /craft_meme_maker with optional caption wording or a theme; without direction, vision invents a funny caption from the photo. Adds one fitted bottom caption to the original photo using PhotoCraft and returns PNG plus an editable project. This recipe captions the photo; it does not generate a replacement image or video.

variables.meme_completion: See the Craft result for completed files or the existing job ID. Inspect or collect a running job instead of starting it again.

steps.description: Look at the photo and write one caption, respecting supplied wording
steps.abort_speech: Could not create a meme caption. Attach one photo using Save to Stash, or include its stash reference.

steps.description: Render the caption on the source photo and retain an editable text layer
steps.abort_speech: The caption was created, but Craft did not finish. Inspect or collect any returned Craft job ID before trying again.

steps.description: Publish the finished meme to Canvas when available

abort_speech: The meme workflow could not finish. Check the failed step before trying again.
